_help: The examples on the page's alert card, chosen by the author (scripts/site_card.py reads this). Each tab names a case of the case set, a run (the run_id in its manifest under data/runs) and a system. A tab with label_by_status takes its label from the agent's actual status. base_case_id/base_run_id: the unedited record of the same patient, shown as 'before the edit'. failures: folded 'where it failed' entries, built the same way; after_run_id is a later run of the same case. 'where' (cpu or gpu) overrides what the backend string says.
